inputs.text: Calling the Rs 700 crore corruption allegations over the proposed Cooperative Department software project “politically motivated” is a way to dodge scrutiny, not answer it. Cooperative institutions rely on public trust and serve their members and communities; if their money is misused, ordinary people bear the cost while those with power evade responsibility. The answer is transparency and independent accountability—not partisan deflection. Those responsible must explain what happened.
